title: The Search for the Anti-aging Pill

sentences.en: As researchers on aging noted recently, no treatment on the market today has been proved to slow human agingthe build-up of molecular and cellular damage that increases vulnerability to infirmity as we grow older.
sentences.zh: 正如老龄问题研究人员最近指出,今天市场上没有任何治疗办法被证明减缓了人类分子和细胞损害的积累,这种损害增加了我们长大后身体虚弱的脆弱性。

grammar.type: 被动语态 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: But one intervention, consumption of a low-calorie yet nutritionally balanced diet, works incredibly well in a broad range of animals, increasing longevity and prolonging good health.
sentences.zh: 但一种干预,即低卡路里但营养平衡的饮食, 在广泛的动物中非常有效, 延长寿命和延长健康。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；分词短语压缩了背景或附加动作。

sentences.en: Those findings suggest that caloric restriction could delay aging and increase longevity in humans, too.
sentences.zh: 这些调查结果表明,卡路里限制热量可能会延缓老龄化,增加人类寿命。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: Unfortunately, for maximum benefit, people would probably have to reduce their caloric intake by roughly thirty per cent, equivalent to dropping from 2,500 calories a day to 1,750.
sentences.zh: 不幸的是,为了获得最大利益,人们很可能不得不将其热量摄入量减少大约30%,相当于从每天2 500卡路里下降到1 750卡路里。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: Few mortals could stick to that harsh a regimen, especially for years on end.
sentences.zh: 很少有人可以坚持这种苛刻的治疗方法,特别是几年后。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: But what if someone could create a pill that mimicked the physiological effects of eating less without actually forcing people to eat less?
sentences.zh: 但如果有人能制造一种药丸模仿吃少而不会迫使人们吃少的生理效应呢?

grammar.type: 状语从句 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；连词引出时间、原因、条件或让步关系；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: Could such a ‘caloric-restriction mimetic’, as we call it, enable people to stay healthy longer, postponing age-related disorders (such as diabetes, arteriosclerosis, heart disease and cancer) until very late in life?
sentences.zh: 是否能够让人们健康长些, 将年龄相关疾病(如糖尿病、动脉硬化、心脏病、癌症)延后至生命深夜?

grammar.type: 分词结构 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；分词短语压缩了背景或附加动作；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: Scientists first posed this question in the mid-1990s, after researchers came upon a chemical agent that in rodents seemed to reproduce many of caloric restriction’s benefits.
sentences.zh: 科学家在1990年代中期首次提出这个问题,当时研究人员发现一种化学剂,在鼠类中似乎会复制许多限制热量的好处。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: No compound that would safely achieve the same feat in people has been found yet, but the search has been informative and has fanned hope that caloric-restriction (CR) mimetics can indeed be developed eventually.
sentences.zh: 还没有找到在人们中安全取得同样成就的化合物,但搜索信息丰富,并使人们希望热量限制的微米药确实能够最终发展。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者。

sentences.en: The benefits of caloric restriction The hunt for CR mimetics grew out of a desire to better understand caloric restriction’s many effects on the body.
sentences.zh: 寻找化学物质微生物的生长是为了更好地了解化学物质对人体的许多影响。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: Scientists first recognized the value of the practice more than 60 years ago, when they found that rats fed a low-calorie diet lived longer on average than free-feeding rats and also had a reduced incidence of conditions that become increasingly common in old age.
sentences.zh: 60多年前,科学家们首先认识到这种做法的价值,发现老鼠喂食低卡路里饮食的平均寿命比免费喂养的老鼠长,而且老年病发病率也有所下降,而老年病越来越普遍。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；连词引出时间、原因、条件或让步关系。

sentences.en: What is more, some of the treated animals survived longer than the oldest-living animals in the control group, which means that the maximum lifespan (the oldest attainable age), not merely the normal lifespan, increased.
sentences.zh: 更有甚者,一些受治疗动物比控制组中最古老的动物存活的时间更长,这意味着最大寿命(可达到的最古老的年龄),而不仅仅是正常寿命,都延长了。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词。

sentences.en: Various interventions, such as infection-fighting drugs, can increase a population’s average survival time, but only approaches that slow the body’s rate of aging will increase the maximum lifespan.
sentences.zh: 各种干预措施,如抗感染药物,可以增加人口的平均存活时间,但只有减缓身体老龄化速度的办法才能延长最长寿命。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: The rat findings have been replicated many times and extended to creatures ranging from yeast to fruit flies, worms, fish, spiders, mice and hamsters.
sentences.zh: 老鼠的发现已多次复制,并扩大到从酵母到水果苍蝇、虫子、鱼、蜘蛛、老鼠和仓鼠等各种生物。

grammar.type: 被动语态 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: Until fairly recently, the studies were limited to short-lived creatures genetically distant from humans.
sentences.zh: 直到最近,这些研究都局限于与人类基因相距遥远的短期生物。

grammar.type: 被动语态 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: But caloric-restriction projects underway in two species more closely related to humansrhesus and squirrel monkeyshave scientists optimistic that CR mimetics could help people.
sentences.zh: 但是在两种与人类关系更密切的物种中正在展开的热量限制项目和松鼠猴子科学家们乐观地认为化学阻燃剂的分子模型可以帮助人类

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: The monkey projects demonstrate that, compared with control animals that eat normally, caloric-restricted monkeys have lower body temperatures and levels of the pancreatic hormone insulin, and they retain more youthful levels of certain hormones that tend to fall with age.
sentences.zh: 猴子项目表明,与正常食用的控制动物相比,受热限制的猴子身体温度较低,胰岛素水平较低,而且它们保留着一些往往随年龄下降的年轻程度的激素。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: The caloric-restricted animals also look better on indicators of risk for age-related diseases.
sentences.zh: 受热限制的动物在与年龄有关的疾病风险指标上也看得更好。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: For example, they have lower blood pressure and triglyceride levels (signifying a decreased likelihood of heart disease), and they have more normal blood glucose levels (pointing to a reduced risk for diabetes, which is marked by unusually high blood glucose levels).
sentences.zh: 例如,他们血液压强和三重血糖水平较低(表明心脏病发病率降低),血液甘蔗糖水平更正常(表明糖尿病风险降低,其特点是血糖水平异常高)。

grammar.type: 定语从句 + 被动语态
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者。

sentences.en: Further, it has recently been shown that rhesus monkeys kept on caloric-restricted diets for an extended time (nearly 15 years) have less chronic disease.
sentences.zh: 此外,最近还表明,恒猴在长时间(近15年)内(在受热限制的饮食中)保持的受限制的饮食中患慢性病较少。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者。

sentences.en: They and the other monkeys must be followed still longer, however, to know whether low-calorie intake can increase both average and maximum lifespans in monkeys.
sentences.zh: 但是,必须更长时间地跟踪猴子和其他猴子,以便了解低热量摄取是否可增加猴子的平均寿命和最长寿命。

grammar.type: 被动语态 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: Unlike the multitude of elixirs being touted as the latest anti-aging cure, CR mimetics would alter fundamental processes that underlie aging.
sentences.zh: 与被称作最新抗衰老疗法的多种灵丹妙药不同,化学元感学将改变老龄化的基本过程。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者。

sentences.en: We aim to develop compounds that fool cells into activating maintenance and repair.
sentences.zh: 我们的目标是开发出能让愚昧细胞启动保养和维修的化合物

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: How a prototype caloric-restriction mimetic works The best-studied candidate for a caloric-restriction mimetic, 2DG (2-deoxy-D-glucose), works by interfering with the way cells process glucose, it has proved toxic at some doses in animals and so cannot be used in humans.
sentences.zh: 热量限制放大技术原型是如何工作的热量限制放大技术的最佳研究对象 2DG (2-脱氧-D-甘甘蔗糖) 干扰细胞过程的葡萄糖, 事实证明它在某些剂量动物中具有毒性,因此不能用于人类。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者。

sentences.en: But it has demonstrated that chemicals can replicate the effects of caloric restriction; the trick is finding the right one.
sentences.zh: 但事实证明,化学品可以复制热量限制的影响;其技巧是找到正确的。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: Cells use the glucose from food to generate ATP (adenosine triphosphate), the molecule that powers many activities in the body.
sentences.zh: 细胞利用食物中的葡萄糖生成ATP(乙酸三磷酸酯),该分子在体内推动许多活动。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: By limiting food intake, caloric restriction minimizes the amount of glucose entering cells and decreases ATP generation.
sentences.zh: 通过限制食物摄取,卡路里限制将进入细胞的葡萄糖量降至最低,并减少ATP代。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: When 2DG is administered to animals that eat normally, glucose reaches cells in abundance but the drug prevents most of it from being processed and thus reduces ATP synthesis.
sentences.zh: 当2DG施用给正常食用动物时,葡萄糖会大量地到达细胞,但该药物阻止大部分细胞被加工,从而减少了ATP合成。

grammar.type: 被动语态 + 状语从句
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者；连词引出时间、原因、条件或让步关系。

sentences.en: Researchers have proposed several explanations for why interruption of glucose processing and ATP production might retard aging.
sentences.zh: 研究人员就葡萄糖加工和ATP生产中断会阻碍老龄化的原因提出了若干解释。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: One possibility relates to the ATP-making machinery’s emission of free radicals, which are thought to contribute to aging and to such age-related diseases as cancer by damaging cells.
sentences.zh: 一种可能性是,ATP机制排放自由基,据认为,这种自由基有助于老龄化,并导致与年龄有关的疾病,如细胞受损导致癌症。

grammar.type: 定语从句 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: Reduced operation of the machinery should limit their production and thereby constrain the damage.
sentences.zh: 机械的操作减少应限制其生产,从而限制损害。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: Another hypothesis suggests that decreased processing of glucose could indicate to cells that food is scarce (even if it isn’t) and induce them to shift into an anti-aging mode that emphasizes preservation of the organism over such ‘luxuries’ as growth and reproduction.
sentences.zh: 另一种假设是,葡萄糖加工的减少可能向细胞表明食物稀缺(即使不是),并诱使它们转向反年龄模式,强调保护生物体,而不是生长和繁殖等 " 奢侈 " 。

grammar.type: 状语从句 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；连词引出时间、原因、条件或让步关系；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

Questions 38-40: Choose no more than TWO words from the passage to complete the flow-chart:

items.prompt: Studies show drugs available today can delay the process of growing old.
There is scientific evidence that eating fewer calories may extend human life.
Not many people are likely to find a caloric-restricted diet attractive.
Diet-related diseases are common in older people.
In experiments, rats who ate what they wanted led shorter lives than rats on a low-calorie diet.
Monkeys were less likely to become diabetic
Monkeys have been shown to experience a longer than average life span
Monkeys enjoyed a reduced chance of heart disease.
Monkeys produced greater quantities of insulin.
In the last paragraph, the writer says that: “.caloric restriction minimizes the amount of glucose entering cells…..” This means that less glucose is produced than normal.
According to the last paragraph, there are two “explanations for why interruption of glucose processing and ATP production might retard aging.”

It is also stated in the last paragraph that: “Another hypothesis suggests that decrease processing of glucose could indicate to cells that food is scarce and induce them to shift into an anti-aging mode that emphasizes preservation of the organism…”
